d: The Delhi government has opened Arvind Kejriwal’s former official residence, dubbed ‘Sheesh Mahal’ by the BJP, to the media, displaying price tags on several amenities and fittings. The listed costs include a Rs 41.16-lakh sliding door, Rs 5.8-lakh toilet and wash basin, and a Rs 7-lakh kitchen dumbwaiter. The government plans to open the bungalow to the public, with a proposed entry fee of around Rs 20. The move has reignited the political controversy over renovation costs, with the BJP highlighting the expenditure and the AAP criticising the exercise.
